reproduction_fidelity: Covariant CHOMP descent with canonical-geometry C-space line-integral obstacle cost; not exact author FR3/hardware reproduction
seed_semantics: deterministic optimizer from fixed validated DRM path; method_seed retained as pairing identity
error: Native DRM reported success, but its seed path failed the common numerical geometry check; no EI-ZO or optimizer call made

timing_scope.cold: worker function entry through final validation/failure; process startup measured separately by outer runner
timing_scope.warm: same actual cold execution minus one-time model/dependency/GPU/roadmap setup; not a second timed solve
timing_scope.offline: DRM construction is recorded separately and never added to query latency

gpu_memory.method: nvidia-smi process allocation; sampled peak, not CUDA allocator exact high water mark
